description: Establish the issue template system (schema + built-in default + project storage) mirrored on the workflow profile model, with list/get API, mo issue template CLI, and a Web UI template selector that prefills the issue body skeleton.

tasks.title: Server foundation: issue-template domain model, built-in mohist/default, registry, and project storage
tasks.description: Add the IssueTemplate domain types (IIssueTemplate with Id/Name/About/IsDefault/SuitableFor/Defaults/Sections; IssueTemplateSection with Title/Guidance/Placeholder; IssueTemplateDefaults with Labels/Risk/Workflow), the IssueTemplates.DefaultId constant, the in-binary MohistDefaultIssueTemplate (5 sections in fixed order with guidance transcribed from the mohist-explore skill), and an IssueTemplateRegistry that merges built-in default + project customs and applies the disable filter. Add ProjectIssueTemplateRow + DbSet + an EF Core migration creating project_issue_templates and the disable flag, mirroring ProjectWorkflowTemplateRow. SuitableFor is typed IReadOnlyList<string> identical to IIssueWorkflowProfile so matching semantics are shared.
acceptanceCriteria: IIssueTemplate, IssueTemplateSection, IssueTemplateDefaults exist with the required fields named in the spec; SuitableFor is IReadOnlyList<string>
IssueTemplates.DefaultId equals "mohist/default"

MohistDefaultIssueTemplate exposes sections in exact order User Voice, Product Shape, Domain Model, Acceptance Criteria, Non-Goals, each with non-empty guidance (sourced from the mohist-explore skill) and a placeholder
IssueTemplateRegistry.List returns the default when not disabled, merges project custom templates, and excludes mohist/default when the project disables it; Get/Exists/Default behave accordingly
An invalid template (missing required frontmatter field, or a section missing title/guidance/placeholder) is rejected and not surfaced
The built-in mohist/default is non-deletable: no delete operation is exposed for built-in defaults in the registry/API/CLI, satisfying the open-box guarantee

EF migration creates project_issue_templates (PK project_id+name, template JSON, created_at, updated_at) and the disable flag; DbSet<ProjectIssueTemplateRow> is registered in MohistDbContext; database starts cleanly
Unit tests cover: default present + section order, project customs merged, disable excludes default, invalid rejected; dotnet test for the new tests passes
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Issue/Domain/IssueTemplate/*, packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Issue/Services/IssueTemplates/*, packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Infrastructure/Data/Issue/ProjectIssueTemplateRow.cs, a new EF Core migration, and unit tests under packages/server/tests/
tasks.notes: Mirror IIssueWorkflowProfile / IssueWorkflowProfileRegistry / ProjectWorkflowTemplateRow. Keep a source-pointer comment in MohistDefaultIssueTemplate.cs naming the skill sections transcribed (no skill changes this issue). Use the IssueTemplate / issue-templates naming consistently to avoid confusion with prompt TemplateRoutes.

tasks.title: API: issue-template list and get endpoints
tasks.description: Add a new Api/IssueTemplateRoutes.cs exposing GET /api/issue-templates (project-scoped via the active project resolution used by other project reads) returning IssueTemplateInfo (Name, About, SuitableFor, IsDefault, Source), and GET /api/issue-templates/{name} returning the full template incl. sections with guidance/placeholder. The list applies the disable filter and includes project customs. Register the route in the app pipeline. This is deliberately separate from the existing prompt TemplateRoutes.cs.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issue-templates returns every available template (non-disabled default + project customs), each item including name, about, suitable_for
GET /api/issue-templates/{name} returns the frontmatter and full sections array; each section includes title, guidance, placeholder
When a project disables mohist/default, GET /api/issue-templates omits it; other projects are unaffected
Endpoints resolve the active project the same way existing project-scoped reads do
API/integration tests cover list-includes-default, get-returns-sections, and disabled-default-excluded; dotnet test passes
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Api/IssueTemplateRoutes.cs, route registration, and API tests under packages/server/tests/
tasks.notes: Do not reuse Api/TemplateRoutes.cs (prompt templates) and do not nest under /api/workflow-*.

tasks.title: CLI: mo issue template list and get
tasks.description: Add a template subcommand to IssueCommands (MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs) with list and get <name> children that consume /api/issue-templates via MohistCliApi, resolve the active project via ResolveProjectIdAsync (as mo issue list does), and render output with the existing TableRenderer. get displays metadata and each section incl. its guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo issue template list` lists the active project's available templates (non-disabled default + customs), each entry identifying the template by name
`mo issue template get <name>` displays the template metadata and its sections, showing each section's guidance
Both commands resolve and target the active project
CLI tests cover list and get command wiring/output; dotnet test passes
tasks.output: packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs (new template subcommand group) and CLI tests under packages/cli/tests/
tasks.notes: Follow the existing IssueCommands subcommand build pattern and MohistCliApi GET helpers.

tasks.title: Web UI: template selector with body skeleton prefill
tasks.description: Add an entities/issue-templates slice (types + useIssueTemplates/useIssueTemplate TanStack Query hooks hitting the new endpoints), mirroring entities/settings's useWorkflowProfiles. Add a TemplateSelector inside features/create-issue/ui/CreateIssueDialog.tsx that populates from useIssueTemplates and, on select, composes the body skeleton client-side by joining '## {section.title}\n{section.placeholder}' in section order; guidance is never written into the body.
acceptanceCriteria: useIssueTemplates/useIssueTemplate hooks call GET /api/issue-templates and GET /api/issue-templates/{name}
CreateIssueDialog shows a template selector populated from the list endpoint (non-disabled default + customs)
Selecting a template prefills the issue body with a section skeleton in section order using each section's placeholder
No section guidance appears in the prefilled body
Web tests (CreateIssueDialog.test.tsx extended) cover selector population and skeleton prefill (guidance excluded, order preserved); npm/vitest tests pass
tasks.notes: Body skeleton is a pure client-side transform of section title+placeholder; defaults (labels/risk/workflow) are advisory and not applied to the form in MVP.
